appearances.name: Gameoverse · Hommage · Kit
appearances.identity: Clothing-only homage to Kit in the official yellow adventurer ensemble. Brown fabric hood with two short triangular cat-ear points and a golden headband, fitted BEHIND Ribbit's two huge frog eyes so neither is hidden; yellow sleeveless tunic with narrow off-white angular center stripe over charcoal short sleeves; charcoal shorts with yellow hems, two large yellow gauntlet cuffs each with a magenta star-shaped crystal inset inside dark circular coral-red ring, green four-finger hands emerging from cuffs. Yellow ankle cuffs over bare green three-toed webbed feet, small pink bow at collar. Crystals are opaque decorative inserts, no glow. Keep long thin frog limbs, frog face, smooth green skin; no cat tail, human hair, human face or new biological cat ears. Adapt Kit's costume, not her body.

appearances.name: Gameoverse · Résident · Cartographe des portails
appearances.identity: Original videogame-world portal cartographer, retaining Ribbit's normal long-limbed lime frog body. Teal short explorer hood-cape with crisp golden angular trim, hood resting behind the huge exposed eyes, small orange star clasp next to pink bow tie; navy short tunic, charcoal knee shorts, narrow brown belt, small brown map satchel with geometric star badge and rolled cream map secured at hip. A small gold lantern-shaped blue-violet opaque crystal case hangs from belt; no aura or glow. Green four-finger hands and bare three-toed webbed feet, teal ankle wraps. Practical scout clothing, no oversized yellow gauntlets, no crown or mechanical body. Use second-reference material/palette continuity without Pomni's human head, jester horns, bells or red-blue anatomy.

appearances.name: Gameoverse · Fusion · Grenouille de cartouche
appearances.identity: True body redesign as a coherent cartridge-world digital amphibian. Retain Ribbit's two gigantic white eye bulges, wedge-cut black pupils, pink cheeks and wide frog smile. Lime-green body formed from crisp beveled polygonal cartridge blocks with royal-blue seam rails, a compact broad torso and articulated angular arms; chunky elongated springless segmented hind legs, broad three-toed geometric feet, four rounded block fingers. Cream belly resembles an inset cartridge label with a simple pink bow-shaped emblem and a small magenta star gem; no words, digits or labels. Small connected square notches on silhouette, a few mint/cyan inset accents, opaque solid body with no floating pixel fragments. A small rectangular cartridge ridge built into the upper back, no real console branding. This is a transformed body rather than armor or an outfit; no jester hat, portals, energy clouds, human skin, cat ears or new weapon.
